arabic_html:
۞ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ خُذُوا۟ زِينَتَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍۢ وَكُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ ۚ
إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ ۞
translation: O children of Adam, take your adornment at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.
explanation_html: Maʿārif-ul-Qurʾān: the verse answers those who thought deprivation was worship. Dress well, eat, drink — the only line drawn is excess.
